page.content:
Whitestone gunslinger whose pepperbox and vengeance open Campaign 1.

How Percival de Rolo connects

  • Faction: Vox Machina — Percy is the gunslinger of Vox Machina.
  • Character: Taliesin Jaffe — Taliesin Jaffe plays Percival de Rolo.
  • Location: Whitestone — Percy is the de Rolo heir of Whitestone.
  • Character: Vex'ahlia — Vex later marries Percy and rules Whitestone with him.

What is Percival de Rolo?

Percival Fredrickstein von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III is Taliesin Jaffe's gunslinger, the Whitestone heir whose barrels and Orthax haunt Vox Machina's early arc.

Key threads lead to Vox Machina, Taliesin Jaffe, Whitestone and Vex'ahlia.
